text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen―― The first direct clash 
with the "Golden Generation." The
opponent 
she crosses swords with is...

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Meeting the spirited gazes of the "Golden 
Generation's" twin pillars, Special Week 
and Grass Wonder, they respond with a 
declaration of victory:
"I'm the one who's gonna win!"

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
—Now, everyone, the tumultuous Act 2 of 
the 'Rise of the End-of-Century Overlord' 
begins!
